clips.title: The story
paras: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition challenges big game hunters to track and bring down the deadliest panthers in Stranglethorn Vale. Following your earlier trials, you must now seek out and slay ten Shadowmaw Panthers.

Sir S. J. Erlgadin considers Shadowmaw Panthers to be the most dangerous cats prowling the jungles of Stranglethorn. Proving your mettle as a true stalker requires crawling through the dense underbrush to track down ten of these elusive beasts, whose ferocity makes them far harder to kill than to find.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now the hard part. A true panther hunter can show skill by dropping Shadowmaw Panthers, the deadliest in Stranglethorn. Prove to us that you can slay 10 of these beasts.
If you think they are hard to track, wait until you attempt to slay one....

clips.title: Progress
paras: What are you doing here, friend! You should be crawling through the brush, trying to kill 10 Shadowmaw Panthers. I thought you fancied yourself a big game hunter?
